en: The image is a vintage black-and-white portrait of a young woman with wavy hair, wearing a lacy blouse and jewelry, posing with a large harp. Her expression is calm and introspective. In the top right corner, the name 'Aino Kajanus' is elegantly written, and in the lower right corner is a code or number: 'P.H. 2639'. The overall style suggests an early 20th-century photographic postcard.
